title.en: Choose a model from the list your agent provides
title.zh: 从智能体提供的列表中选择模型

description.en: When adding an agent, the models offered by its account appear in a list. A model that is not listed can still be entered as a custom model ID.
description.zh: 添加智能体时，其账号可用的模型会以列表形式列出；列表以外的模型仍可通过自定义模型 ID 填写。

title.zh: 工作区各处控件样式统一

description.en: Loading indicators, confirmation prompts, option pickers, labels and hints now share the same appearance throughout the Workspace.
description.zh: 加载提示、确认弹窗、选项切换、标签与提示信息在工作区各处采用统一的样式。

title.zh: 智能体更新操作更加清晰

description.en: The update button on an agent's setup page spans the side panel, and the update confirmation shows the full command on a single line.
description.zh: 智能体配置页侧栏中的更新按钮改为整栏宽度；更新确认弹窗将完整命令显示在同一行。

title.en: Model names are no longer accepted as model IDs
title.zh: 不再将模型显示名误作模型 ID

description.en: Entering a model's display name, such as "Opus 5 with 1M context", now points to its model ID instead of creating an agent that fails on its first reply.
description.zh: 填写模型的显示名（例如「Opus 5 with 1M context」）时，会提示对应的模型 ID，避免创建出首次回复即报错的智能体。
